 INTERNSHIP - CAE Engineer (M/F)

 Hungry for challenges? Join a group with innovation at its heart and contribute to the automotive revolution!

 OPmobility is a world-leading provider of innovative solutions for a unique, safer and more sustainable mobility experience. Innovation-driven since its creation, the Group develops and produces intelligent exterior systems, customized complex modules, lighting systems, clean energy systems and electrification solutions for all mobility companies. With a €11.4 billion economic revenue in 2023, a global network of 152 plants and 40 R&D centers, OPmobility relies on its 40,300 employees to meet the challenges of transforming mobility.

 A world leader in hydrogen mobility, OPmobility H2-Power develops storage systems and solutions for all types of hydrogen mobility: cars, trucks and trains. The business expertise covers the entire value chain of fuel cell electric vehicles through high-pressure hydrogen storage solutions, fuel cell manufacturing and an integrated hydrogen system that ensures the smooth operation of on-board technologies.

 Our ambition? Provide automakers with cutting-edge equipment and solutions to develop tomorrow’s clean and connected car.

 Job Description 

 Within the Engineering Product Validation Department, you will be responsible for evaluating and implementing artificial intelligence approaches applied to structural analysis, with the aim of improving the efficiency and reliability of numerical product validation for tailgates and bumpers. 

 Desired start date: March 2027  
Duration: 6 months 

 Main responsibilities: 

- 

 Define and create a database tailored to the study requirements. 

- 

 Perform static simulations using Abaqus or crash simulations using Radioss to generate training cases. 

- 

 Train 3D geodesic convolutional models based on artificial intelligence. 

- 

 Deploy these models and evaluate their performance within the end-user application. 

 Candidate profile: 

- 

 You are currently pursuing a Master's degree (Bac+5) in Mechanical Engineering or Mechanical Modelling and Applications. 

- 

 You have an advanced level of English (B2/C1). 

- 

 You have intermediate to advanced skills in mechanics. Knowledge of plastics engineering would be an advantage. 

- 

 You have in-depth knowledge of CAE and Deep Learning. 

- 

 You have a very good command of Python. 

- 

 You are proficient in using Abaqus, Radioss, and HyperMesh. 

- 

 You are proactive, demonstrate strong communication and analytical skills, and take initiative in carrying out your assignments. 

 Location: Sigmatech – Avenue du Bois des Vergnes, 01150 Sainte-Julie (40 km from Lyon, carpooling available) 

 Compensation & Benefits: 

 Compensation will depend on your level of study. Other benefits are also available at our site, including a transportation allowance, employer contribution towards meals at the company restaurant, access to a gym, concierge services, and more.  
 As a responsible company, OPmobility pays particular attention to diversity and equality within its teams and the Group commits to treat all job applications equally.

Company: 
Qualcomm Canada ULC 
 Job Area: 
Interns Group, Interns Group > Interim Engineering Intern - Systems 
 Qualcomm Overview: 
 Qualcomm is a company of inventors that unlocked 5G ushering in an age of rapid acceleration in connectivity and new possibilities that will transform industries, create jobs, and enrich lives. But this is just the beginning. It takes inventive minds with diverse skills, backgrounds, and cultures to transform 5Gs potential into world-changing technologies and products. This is the Invention Age - and this is where you come in. 

 General Summary: 
 About Qualcomm  
 Qualcomm relentlessly innovates transforming businesses, enriching lives and fortifying societies. Our solutions are pivotal in crafting a smarter, interconnected world. Building on our nearly 40-year history of era-defining technology breakthroughs, we deliver leading-edge AI, high performance, lower-power computing, and unrivaled connectivity. We’re proud to be the partner of choice to many of the world’s largest enterprises. Together with our ecosystem partners, we enable next-generation digital transformation. At Qualcomm, we are engineering human progress. 

 Join Us in Shaping the Future  
 At Qualcomm, we're committed to engineering human progress by delivering intelligent computing everywhere. We're passionate about harnessing the power of technology to transform industries and improve lives. Our early career programs offer limitless opportunities for growth, mentorship, and meaningful work. By joining our team, you'll be part of a community that's pushing the boundaries of what's possible in AI, computing, and connectivity. With a global footprint spanning over 30 countries, you'll have the chance to collaborate with diverse talent and contribute to projects that are shaping the future of technology. 

 Our early career programs are designed to attract inventive minds, offering a platform to contribute to our long-term innovation pipeline. You'll be part of a community that values collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning. Our programs provide real-world experience, technical skills, and professional development opportunities, empowering you to make a meaningful impact and achieve your career goals. Join us for our 2027 intern class in Markham, Canada ! 

 Maximize Your Opportunities: 
Our internship hiring model routes candidates from this application into multiple project specific roles. Your "Profile Visibility" choice will guide how we manage your data across our systems. To be considered for the full breadth of internship opportunities, select the option to use your profile data for "Any Roles Globally". 

 If you choose to limit your data to "Only The Role I'm Applying For", it will restrict the opportunity for you to be considered across matching internship opportunities.  

 You can update your profile visibility preferences at any time through the Candidate Home Portal. 

 Steps: 

- Log Into Your Eightfold Candidate Home Account  

- Hover Over The "Profile" Dropdown    

- Open Settings  

- Edit "Profile Visibility"  

 Role Overview  
 As an Intern on the Machine Learning Systems Team , you will work at the intersection of machine learning, compiler technology, and AI hardware architecture. You will collaborate closely with software, firmware, performance architecture, and hardware teams to improve the execution of state-of-the-art AI models on Qualcomm's Neural Processing Unit (NPU).

 The ML Systems team focuses on two key areas:

- Development and evolution of production and next-generation ML/AI compilers for efficient mapping of AI workloads to Qualcomm hardware.

- Analysis of ML/AI algorithms and workloads to help shape future Qualcomm hardware and software innovations.

 The team develops and maintains production compiler technology that ships as part of the Qualcomm AI Runtime SDK and is used to accelerate AI workloads across Qualcomm platforms. In addition, the team builds and utilizes performance modeling and simulation tools to evaluate current and future AI architectures.

 This role provides a unique opportunity to develop both software and hardware expertise while working with state-of-the-art AI models, including large language models (LLMs), multimodal models, computer vision networks, and generative AI workloads. Interns will gain exposure to hardware/software co-design and help evaluate tradeoffs between performance, power efficiency, memory utilization, and programmability.

 To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation process, candidates are expected to complete all interviews independently. The use of generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, Gemini, or similar technologies) during interviews is not permitted unless explicitly authorized by the interviewer.

 Responsibilities may include: 
 Analyze and Improve Performance 

- Compile and optimize neural networks for execution on Qualcomm AI accelerators

- Analyze model performance and identify opportunities to improve compiler algorithms, runtime efficiency, and hardware utilization

- Prototype algorithms that enable AI workloads to execute with high performance and low power consumption on Qualcomm hardware

- Identify bottlenecks in compute and the memory hierarchy

- Recommend software and hardware enhancements to improve overall system performance and efficiency

 Compiler and System Optimization 

- Contribute to Qualcomm's ML compiler stack to improve performance, efficiency, scalability, and developer productivity.

- Explore and prototype optimization techniques for emerging AI workloads and state-of-the-art neural network architectures.

- Analyze ML workloads to help guide future hardware and software feature development.

 Performance Modeling and Simulation 

- Develop performance models and simulation infrastructure using Python, C, and C++.

- Evaluate current and future Qualcomm AI accelerators and predict workload performance before silicon is available.

 Minimum Qualifications: 

- Proficiency in Python or C++

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Detail-oriented with a passion for solving complex technical problems

 Preferred Qualifications: 

- Strong knowledge of Python and/or C/C++

- Familiarity with object-oriented design principles

- Experience with software development tools and workflows, including Git, CI/CD systems, Linux, and SSH

- Experience with Algorithms and Data Structures

- Coursework, Research, or Project Experience in one or more of the following:

- Machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, ONNX, TensorFlow, or JAX

- Model optimization and deployment

- Large language models (LLMs), generative AI, or multimodal AI

- AI accelerator architecture (NPU, GPU, DSP, or related architecture)

- Computer architecture and memory systems

- Performance modeling, simulation, and profiling

- Operating systems and systems software

- High-performance computing

 Education Requirements: 

- In study towards a bachelor’s degree in one of the following: Engineering Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Computer Science, or related field 

- For 16-month internships: must be available May/June 2027 - August/September 2028

- Expected graduation date of November 2028 or later.

 Qualcomm’s Internship Program  
 Our interns join world-class teams to help define and build what is next for mobility and the world. You’ll be paired with a mentor with visibility to your project and team, receive support from your manager, and have access to the entire Qualcomm employee community to ensure your success. To round out your internship, we host professional development workshops, social events, cross-functional speaker sessions, and an executive speaker series. In addition to competitive hourly pay and accrued vacation time, you will receive housing stipend to accommodate for the duration of your internship. 

 Application Process   
 We will review resumes on an ongoing basis, and a recruiter may reach out to you. Advancing candidates may be invited to complete a timed HackerRank challenge to evaluate their technical skill set. 

 Export Control Notice  
 This role may require an export license for candidates with citizenship in certain countries (see current country list below – subject to change). Qualcomm, like other companies, is experiencing significant delays in the export license process. Please be advised that if an export license is required, you may not be able to start work with Qualcomm until the license is granted, which may impact your ability to participate in the internship. 
 Countries requiring export : Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Burma (Myanmar), Cambodia, China, Cuba, Georgia, Hong Kong, Iran, Iraq, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Laos, Libya, Macau, Moldova, Mongolia, Nicaragua, North Korea, Russia, Sudan, Syria, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Ukraine, Uzbekistan, Venezuela, Vietnam, and Yemen.

 Applicants : Qualcomm is an equal opportunity employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need an accommodation during the application/hiring process, rest assured that Qualcomm is committed to providing an accessible process. You may e-mail  myhr.support@qualcomm.com  or call Qualcomm's toll-free number found  here . Upon request, Qualcomm will provide reasonable accommodations to support individuals with disabilities to be able participate in the hiring process. Qualcomm is also committed to making our workplace accessible for individuals with disabilities. 

 Qualcomm expects its employees to abide by all applicable policies and procedures, including but not limited to security and other requirements regarding protection of Company confidential information and other confidential and/or proprietary information, to the extent those requirements are permissible under applicable law. 

 To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies:   Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Qualcomm. Staffing and recruiting agencies and individuals being represented by an agency are not authorized to use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes, and any such submissions will be considered unsolicited. Qualcomm does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Qualcomm employees or any other company location. Qualcomm is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications. 

 Pay range and Other Compensation & Benefits: 
$54,600.00 - $103,350.00 
 The above pay scale reflects the broad, minimum to maximum, pay scale for this job code for the location for which it has been posted. Even more importantly, please note that salary is only one component of total compensation at Qualcomm.  We also offer a competitive annual discretionary bonus program and opportunity for annual RSU grants (employees on sales-incentive plans are not eligible for our annual bonus).  In addition, our highly competitive benefits package is designed to support your success at work, at home, and at play. Your recruiter will be happy to discuss all that Qualcomm has to offer.

 If you would like more information about this role, please contact Qualcomm Careers .

 Role Overview  

 At Qualcomm Canada, our Mixed Signal IP Firmware and Embedded Software team in Toronto develops the embedded software that powers Qualcomm’s high-performance, multi-standard SerDes PHY and die-to-die interconnect IP. Our IP supports standards such as PCIe, Ethernet, CXL, and UCIe and is integrated into SoCs, ASICs, and chiplets for AI data center , networking, and compute applications.   

 The team owns the full embedded software stack that controls the hardware, including low-level firmware running on RISC-V-based controllers, customer-facing C and Python SDKs, lab tools and GUIs for interactive debug, and the build, regression, and continuous integration infrastructure that keeps our releases healthy. We are a key enabler of silicon bring-up, validation, and production deployment, and we work closely with digital design, design verification, silicon validation, systems, and DevOps teams.   

 Under the guidance of an experienced engineer and a dedicated mentor, interns contribute directly to shipping firmware and SDK releases. This posting covers two project areas on the same team: Embedded Firmware and SDK Development, and Firmware Tooling, Test Automation, and CI. Candidates will be considered for both areas, with the final match determined during the interview process.   

 No prior semiconductor background is required. Through hands-on work, you will learn how software and silicon interact and how a feature progresses from simulation to emulation and real silicon in the lab.   

 Responsibilities may include: 

- Writing and debugging low-level C firmware and device drivers that configure, calibrate, monitor, and control high-speed SerDes and die-to-die interconnect hardware   

- Extending customer-facing C and Python SDK features for link bring-up, calibration, tuning, diagnostics, error monitoring, and register access   

- Porting and optimizing firmware so that it runs consistently across simulation, emulation, FPGA, and real-silicon environments   

- Building Python tooling, lab automation, regression tests, and test frameworks that improve firmware quality and development efficiency   

- Improving build, release, and continuous integration flows used to validate firmware and software across multiple hardware platforms   

- Developing interactive debug tools, command-line utilities, GUIs, and dashboards that make link health and test coverage visible   

- Investigating firmware, software, and hardware integration issues and driving them toward root cause with cross-functional engineering teams   

- Working in the lab alongside firmware, design, verification, systems, and validation engineers to bring up and debug silicon   

- Contributing to technical documentation, code reviews, test plans, and reliable firmware and SDK releases   

 Preferred Qualifications:     

- Experience programming in C and Python   

- Knowledge of embedded systems, microcontrollers, computer architecture, memory-mapped registers, or device drivers   

- Experience with Linux development environments, command-line tools, and shell scripting   

- Relevant academic, personal, open-source, or industry project experience   

- Experience with Git and collaborative software development practices   

- Familiarity with build systems, automated testing, regression infrastructure, or CI tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins   

- Knowledge of digital logic, computer hardware, or hardware/software interfaces   

- Familiarity with Verilog or SystemVerilog and hardware simulation or emulation environments   

- Exposure to communication protocols or high-speed interfaces such as Ethernet, PCIe, CXL, or UCIe   

- Experience with lab equipment, FPGA platforms, microcontroller boards, or silicon bring-up is an asset   

- Strong debugging, problem-solving, and analytical skills   

- Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills   

- Ability to learn quickly and work effectively as part of a collaborative, cross-functional team

 This is a general applicant portal for Indigenous student talent (First Nations, Metis and Inuit) to apply to opportunities across our bank, it is not tied to one specific job or department, rather it is an opportunity to connect with us and discover where your talents fit at CIBC. 

 We’re more interested in who you are and not just your professional experience, so even if you don’t feel you’re “fully qualified”, have existing financial services knowledge or you’re just not sure about applying to work at a bank, we’d still love to hear from you! No matter what your strengths and experiences are, we invite you to submit a resume so we can get to know you and help you find your next opportunity at CIBC where you can thrive and grow.

 Job opportunities across CIBC are as diverse as our employees and clients themselves; we hire folks from chemical engineers to art curators to work in all kinds of positions such as analysts, consultants, coordinators, leaders, frontline support and everything in between. CIBC offers a hugely diverse world of opportunity for you to learn and develop with us, along with a supportive and thoroughly modern workplace culture. Being a bank does not mean being stuck in a suit and tie, nor does it mean covering your true self when coming to work. At CIBC we encourage you to be your authentic self every day, which means tattoos, piercings and traditional hairstyles will never be discriminated against. 
 When you join CIBC as a student, you will be making a real difference for our clients, our team and our community. You will be using your strong interpersonal, communication and technical skills to assist our teams with a number of different projects and priorities.

- We have positions available across Canada and various on-site, hybrid and remote work arrangements are available. All CIBC opportunities require you to be based in Canada for the duration of the term.

- Duration of work terms available are 4, 8, 12, and 16 months.

- This job posting will be continuously reviewed by our campus recruitment team.

 How you’ll succeed 

- Relationship Management –  Engage with people and develop strong communities around you. You are able to maintain relationships with people both on your team and from other areas. 

- Communication – Communicate effectively and comfortable speaking to a range of people. You can understand information and explain it clearly to other people.

- Learning – Passionate about growing your knowledge and developing your skillsets. You enjoy learning and trying new things and aren’t afraid to take on something new. 

 Who you are 

- You engage with your heart and mind . You care about people and understand different perspectives. You listen and learn from the experiences of others.

- You're driven to succeed. You are motivated by accomplishing your goals and delivering your best to make an impact.

Please note this posting is to advertise potential job opportunities. This exact role may not be open today but could open in the near future. When you apply, a Cisco representative may contact you directly if a relevant position opens.

 Applications are accepted until further notice.   

 Meet the Team   

 Our dedicated team members are building the future of Cisco’s core networking platforms, operating systems, and intelligent embedded infrastructure, powering global connectivity. You will join engineering teams focused on developing high-performance routing and switching architectures, low-latency telemetry, and hardware-software integration within business groups such as Cisco Networking , Security & Trust, and Supply Chain. As part of this collaborative environment, you will contribute to the evolution of next-generation distributed platforms and mission-critical network systems. Explore the opportunities at the intersection of embedded software, networking protocols, and silicon systems, helping to transform how Cisco delivers resilient, high-speed digital experiences worldwide.   

 Your Impact   

 As an Embedded Systems Software Developer Co-op, you will contribute to the design, enhancement, and testing of foundational software powering Cisco’s networking platforms and intelligent devices. You will collaborate with experienced engineers and cross-functional teams to develop dependable software components, explore innovative technical approaches, and help solve real-world systems challenges. Engage in all phases of the software development lifecycle, from initial concept and prototyping to testing, debugging, and continuous improvement. Success in this role means learning industry best practices, applying your technical curiosity to complex systems, and delivering features that enhance the performance and reliability of our global products.   

 Minimum Qualifications   

- Currently enrolled in an undergraduate degree program   (Associate's or Bachelor's)   

- Qualifying education should be in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field. 

- Foundational programming and problem-solving skills in C or C++, with coursework or personal project experience in data structures, algorithms, and memory management.   

- Understanding of core computer science fundamentals, including operating systems concepts (processes, threads, concurrency) and basic networking principles (TCP/IP stack, Ethernet, routing/switching).   

- Familiarity with standard software development workflows in Linux environments and Git version control.   

 Preferred Qualifications   

- Hands-on academic or project experience with Embedded Linux, POSIX system calls, device drivers, or microcontroller programming.   

- Familiarity with networking protocols (such as BGP, OSPF, VLANs, or packet capture tools like Wireshark/ tcpdump ).   

- Experience scripting in Python or Bash for test automation, build systems, or CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions).   

- Exposure to hardware/software co-design, FPGA fundamentals, or low-level debugging using GDB and JTAG.   

- Strong analytical troubleshooting skills, eager technical curiosity, and an ability to collaborate effectively in an agile engineering team.   

 Why Cisco? 
 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 
 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Purpose. Performance. People. 

 Joining CPP Investments means joining one of the world’s most admired and respected institutional investors to drive a single mandate: to deliver strong, sustainable returns for generations of Canadians.   

 With a long-term horizon and global reach, we deploy capital at scale across public and private markets. Our size, stability, and disciplined investment philosophy allow us to pursue complex opportunities and build enduring partnerships worldwide.  

 For our people, this means meaningful work with tangible impact, real opportunity, and collaboration with exceptional colleagues who value partnership and performance. Here, you’ll contribute to outcomes that matter alongside team members committed to excellence and shared success.   

 The Role 

As an Intern Analyst in the Systematic Strategies Group (SSG), you will contribute to systematic investment research across global markets and multiple asset classes.
Starting in May 2027, you will support end-to-end research on systematic signals, develop forecasting and monitoring tools using macroeconomic, market and alternative datasets, engineer robust data workflows, and help translate academic research into enhancements to investment models. 

 The Team 

 The Capital Markets and Factor Investing (CMF) department invests globally across public equities, fixed income securities, currencies, commodities and derivatives, and manages relationships with investment managers and co-investments in public market securities.

 Within CMF, the Systematic Strategies Group develops and manages systematic investment strategies across global equities, fixed income, commodities, currencies and volatility. The team invests in absolute return and long-only strategies designed to provide a diversifying return stream to the total Fund.

 Accountabilities 

- Support end-to-end research on systematic signals across multiple asset classes, including rates, equities, currencies and commodities

- Build forecasting and monitoring tools that synthesize macroeconomic, market and alternative datasets

- Engineer robust data workflows to support systematic investment research

- Translate relevant academic research into enhancements to investment models

- Contribute to practical research related to financial markets, portfolio management, portfolio construction and asset pricing

 Qualifications 

- Currently pursuing a PhD in Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics or a related quantitative discipline; candidates at the dissertation stage are preferred

- Experience working with financial and/or economic data

- Strong programming skills, preferably in Python and SQL

- Strong empirical modelling, econometric, analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and intellectual curiosity

- Interest in applying quantitative research to financial markets, portfolio management, portfolio construction and asset pricing

- Strong written and verbal communication skills and demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively within a team

- Commitment to CPP Investments’ Guiding Principles of Integrity, Partnership and High Performance

 You are motivated to contribute to something larger than yourself, approach complex challenges with rigor, and hold yourself to  high standards in a collaborative, performance-driven environment.   

 We provide colleagues with cutting-edge AI tools, dedicated learning time, and practical support to help them deliver with greater impact.

 Inclusion & Accessibility 
 CPP Investments is committed to  equitable access to employment and building a workforce that reflects diverse talent and perspectives. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.   

 Attention: Protect Yourself from Fraud 
 CPP Investments is committed to a secure and transparent recruitment process. We will never ask candidates for payment or financial information at any stage of hiring. All legitimate opportunities are posted on our careers page, and communications will come from our applicant tracking system, Workday.  

 CPP Investments may use AI tools to help screen and assess applicants by analyzing resumes and applications for relevant skills and experience. These tools support, but do not replace, human decision-making.

Who we are: 

 Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities. 

 Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes. 

 Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our  blog  and follow us @InsideGeotab on  Instagram .  

 Who you are: 

 As a Solutions Delivery Intern, you are a highly motivated and eager individual with a strong interest in project management and technology. You are keen to learn the ropes of managing complex projects and contributing to the successful delivery of innovative products. Your strong communication skills, eagerness to learn, and commitment to continuous improvement make you a valuable asset to our organization. You thrive in collaborative environments and are excited to work alongside experienced professionals, supporting them in streamlining processes and driving product initiatives. 

 What you'll do: 

 In this role, you will gain hands-on experience in the world of solutions delivery by supporting our Solutions Delivery Managers and cross-functional teams. You will assist in streamlining processes, contribute to complex projects, and gain exposure to the full technical, operational, business and market lifecycle of a feature or product – from conception to release.  Your responsibilities will include assisting with defining project scope, supporting the management of timelines, and ensuring smooth execution of tasks, all while continuously learning and developing your skills. 

 The opportunity: 

- 12 month work-term beginning January 2027. 

- Full-time, paid internship: Monday - Friday, 37.5hrs/week. 

- Your first week at Geotab begins with 'GEO Launch' - a one-week Employee Orientation. Click  here  to learn more! 

- Learn more about the Geotab Campus Program  here . 

- This posting is for an existing vacancy. 

 How you'll make an impact: 

- Support product initiatives throughout the product lifecycle, gaining valuable insights into the journey from conception to release. 

- Assist in defining project scope, goals, and deliverables. Contribute to the creation and management of project timelines/schedules, ensuring timely delivery of product milestones. 

- Provide support to complex projects and product initiatives involving coordination with multi-disciplinary teams at Geotab. Assist in facilitating effective communication, aligning visions, and ensuring accountability for required work/deliverables. 

- Assist in coordinating internal team activities and supporting project meetings. Help maintain detailed meeting minutes and follow up on action items. 

- Contribute to establishing and maintaining project deliverables, timelines, and milestone updates for sponsors and key stakeholders. 

- Assist in analyzing project issues and developing solutions. Learn to anticipate potential problems and proactively address them. 

- Assist in gathering and documenting stakeholder requirements for specific products and translating requirements into detailed technical specifications. 

- Participate in post-mortem reviews post-product delivery or as required within the project delivery process. 

- Support project communication and reporting. Assist with project tracking and analysis. Contribute to communicating vital information to the project team and broader product teams. 

- Assist in preparing and presenting regular progress reports to stakeholders and senior management. 

- Engage in establishing best practices, templates, policies, tools, and partnerships to enhance organizational capabilities. 

- Platform: manage shared infrastructure that enables solutions (e.g. identity, core platform) 

 What you'll bring to the role: 

- Currently pursuing a degree in a related field (e.g., Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering) 

- A strong interest in project/program management or product ownership within a technology organization. 

- Knowledge or a strong desire to learn about the high-technology industry. 

- Excellent academic record and a demonstrated ability to learn quickly. 

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to problem-solve and make well-judged decisions. 

- Highly organized and able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously. 

- Able to work well under pressure and respond to changing priorities. 

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 

- Strong interpersonal relationship-building skills. 

- A strong team player with the ability to engage with all levels of the organization. 

 If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. 

 Please note: Geotab does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Geotab employees. 

 How we work: 

 At Geotab, we have adopted a flexible hybrid working model in that we have systems, functions, programs and policies in place to support both in-person and virtual work. However, you are welcomed and encouraged to come into our beautiful, safe, clean offices as often as you like. When working from home, you are required to have a reliable internet connection with at least 50mb DL/10mb UL. Virtual work is supported with cloud-based applications, collaboration tools and asynchronous working. The health and safety of employees are a top priority. We encourage work-life balance and keep the Geotab culture going strong with online social events, chat rooms and gatherings. Join us and help reshape the future of technology! 

 We believe that ensuring diversity is fundamental to our future growth and progress and is an integral part of our business. We believe that success happens where new ideas can flourish – in an environment that is rich in diversity and a place where people from various backgrounds can work together. Geotab encourages applications from all qualified individuals. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities during the recruitment and assessment processes and when people are hired. We will ensure the accessibility needs of employees with disabilities are taken into account as part of performance management, career development, training and redeployment processes. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process or want more information about our diversity and inclusion as well as accommodation policies and practices, please contact us at careers@geotab.com. By submitting a job application to Geotab Inc. or its affiliates and subsidiaries (collectively, “Geotab”), you acknowledge Geotab’s collection, use and disclosure of your personal data in accordance with our Privacy Policy . Click here to read our Privacy Notice.  

 This role offers an hourly pay range which is anticipated to be the range listed below. The actual pay for this position depends on a variety of factors such as but not limited to student's academic program, relevant experience, and location. Geotab is committed to fair and equitable compensation and will share final details as part of the offer process. All offers of employment are contingent upon proof of eligibility to work for the duration of the internship and the individual's ability to pass a background check.

 Hourly Rate
 $20 — $27 CAD

With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

 Overview: A chip isn't a product until it's a working system. These teams cover both ends of that: getting silicon to boot and validate correctly,building the board, power, mechanical, thermal, packaging and IO around it. You submit one application, you have one recruiter screen - then we match you to the specific team below and location that fits best.

- Systems & Silicon Validation: Post-silicon testing of physical chips and integrated systems to ensure they meet all functional, electrical, and performance specs.

- System Software: Development of foundational software, including firmware, drivers, and operating systems, that directly controls and interfaces with hardware.

- System Design: The process of defining, integrating, and mapping out hardware components such as PCBs, software modules, and interfaces into a complete product blueprint.

- System Architecture: Define the high-level structural framework, interfaces, and data-flow pathways between the CPU, memory, and peripherals.

- Packaging: A package is what is placed between the silicon and the board; and its design requires detailed electrical, electromagnetic, and mechanical simulations and analysis. 

 This role is on-site based out of Toronto, Ontario or Vancouver, British Columbia.

 Who You Are 

- Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in EE, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or Mechanical Engineering

- Coursework or projects in embedded systems, microwave and signal integrity, board-level design, or thermal/mechanical engineering using low-level programming (C/C++, Python) or hardware design and/or simulation tools (e.g., CAD, FEA, Verilog).

- Problem solver with strong foundational knowledge in one of these areas: electrical engineering, digital logic, computer architecture, or thermal/mechanical.

- Curious learner who is passionate about the intersection of software, silicon architecture, and the physical constraints of chip packaging and printed circuit boards (PCBs).

 What We Need 

- Systems & Silicon Validation: Assist in post-silicon testing of physical microchips under real-world workloads to ensure they meet all functional, electrical, and performance specifications.

- System Software: Contribute to developing foundational software—including firmware, drivers, and operating systems—that directly controls and interfaces with the semiconductor hardware.

- System Design & Architecture: Help map out, define, and evaluate high-level structural frameworks, optimizing the power delivery and high-speed performance benchmarks of both the silicon components and the underlying PCBs.

- Semiconductor Packaging & Mechanical Design: Design and layout, Electromagnetic (signal integrity and power integrity), mechanical design, and stress analysis

 What You Will Learn 

- Hands-on silicon experience using industry-standard lab equipment to bridge the gap between theoretical hardware design, physical packaging layouts, and real-world chips.

- Low-level software development by writing production-grade firmware, device drivers, and diagnostic tools that run directly on bare metal.

- Mechanical & thermal engineering for electronics by learning how structural stress, heat dissipation, thermal expansion, and mechanical shock affect the structural integrity and performance of PCBs and packages.

- Cross-functional collaboration working alongside world-class architects, mechanical designers, package engineers, and software teams to understand how complex, large-scale chip ecosystems are built from scratch.

 Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer. 

 This offer of employment is contingent upon the applicant being eligible to access U.S. export-controlled technology. These requirements apply to persons located in the U.S. and all countries outside the U.S. As the position offered will have direct and/or indirect access to information, systems, or technologies subject to these laws, the offer may be contingent upon your citizenship/permanent residency status or ability to obtain prior license approval from the U.S. Commerce Department or applicable federal agency. If employment is not possible due to U.S. export laws, any offer of employment will be rescinded.

WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role?

Ship state of the art models to production.

Design and implement novel research ideas.

Build elegant training/deployment pipelines.

Join us at a pivotal moment, shape what we build and wear multiple hats as an intern!


Our recruitment process will begin in the upcoming weeks, and we will be carefully reviewing applications and assessing potential candidates for our internships. Should we find a suitable match with your qualifications and our requirements, we will be in touch to discuss the opportunity further and to advance your application to the next stage

Please Note: To be eligible for this position you should be a student currently enrolled in a post-secondary program, available for a full-time 3-6 month internship, co-op, or research work term.



As a Machine Learning Intern, you will:

 - Design, train and improve upon cutting-edge models.

 - Help us develop new techniques to train and serve models safer, better, and faster.

 - Train extremely large-scale models on massive datasets.

 - Explore continual and active learning strategies for streaming data.

 - Learn from experienced senior machine learning technical staff.

 - Work closely with product teams to develop solutions.
   
   

You may be a good fit if you have:

 - Proficiency in Python and related ML frameworks such as Tensorflow, TF-Serving, JAX, and XLA/MLIR.

 - Experience using large-scale distributed training strategies.

 - Familiarity with autoregressive sequence models, such as Transformers.

 - Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

 - A demonstrated passion for applied NLP models and products.

 - Bonus: experience writing kernels for GPUs using CUDA.

 - Bonus: experience training on TPUs.

 - Bonus: papers at top-tier venues (such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AIStats, MLSys, JMLR, AAAI, Nature, COLING, ACL, EMNLP).




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

BUILD SOMETHING PEOPLE LOVE

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $155 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.



We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/culture and learn more about how we work https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/careers.




INTERN, CLIENT EXPERIENCE STRATEGY & OPERATIONS (WINTER 2027)

Location: Toronto, ON (Hybrid)

Term: 8 months, beginning January 11, 2027. 



This is an 8 month internship designed for co-op students, non-co-op students, and recent graduates who are ready to ship impactful work.

During your internship, you will have the opportunity to contribute to projects that are changing the landscape of financial services for Canadians. You will be on a team that supports your growth, provides mentorship, and connects you to the broader Wealthsimple community!

Our internship program operates on a hybrid model, where you’ll be working from our Toronto headquarters on Wednesdays and Thursdays. This structure offers the flexibility of remote work, while also providing the collaboration, connection, and mentorship that come from being together in person.



This posting covers two tracks: Workflow Optimization and Enablement. Please apply to the one that best fits your interests.

Please note: the role you apply for is the role you will be assessed on throughout the interview process. We are unable to accommodate requests to switch between Workflow Optimization and Enablement tracks after submission.



 


ABOUT THE CX OPERATIONS TEAM

The CX Operations team is responsible for enabling exceptional client and agent experiences across Wealthsimple through optimized systems, content, AI solutions, and strategic initiatives. We manage the technology, knowledge, and processes that power our customer experience organization, driving continuous improvement in efficiency and effectiveness.

 


CHOOSE YOUR TRACK:

 


WORKFLOW OPTIMIZATION, INTERN

Workflow Optimization (WFO) streamlines the workflows, systems, and automations that span our entire ecosystem of tools. We partner with teams across the organization to identify and simplify toilsome workflows through process mapping, automation, and AI tool implementations.

As a WFO Intern, you'll partner with WFO managers and internal SMEs to: design and build AI tools for analysis; audit and improve automations; map and redesign workflows; and deliver measurable improvements in containment, resolution time, and operational risk.

You'll develop core skills in project planning, process design, AI tool deployment, and AI‑enhanced automation while contributing directly to CX efficiency and client experience.

 


IN THIS ROLE, YOU’LL HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO

 - Partner with the AI Experiences team to launch net-new features to our clients and support agents.

 - Map current-state workflows with SMEs, identify optimization opportunities, and implement AI-enhanced changes across macros, automations, and documentation.

 - Build comprehensive automation inventories across multiple systems, to propose consolidations and net-new automations and AI optimizations.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Structured problem solving and process thinking, with the ability to translate ambiguous workflows into clear maps and requirements

 - Basic familiarity with AI concepts (LLM, RAG, context windows, hallucination, etc.)

 - Basic familiarity with customer operations tools or ticketing systems (Zendesk, JIRA)

 - Basic familiarity with data and testing concepts – to be applied in the context of testing the accuracy of AI models (A/B testing, sample sizes, statistical significance, etc.)

 - Strong documentation and communication skills to collaborate with SMEs and present proposals

 - Bias to action and ownership to drive projects from discovery to implementation







ENABLEMENT, INTERN

Our enablement group is responsible for how our support workforce learns, performs, and grows. We build the systems, programs, and culture that keep our support teams performing at a high bar. Quality, learning, change readiness, and performance measurement all sit within this group. Underneath all of it is a simple belief: every client interaction should be fast, high-quality, and trustworthy. Our job is to turn that belief into measurable reality.

As an Enablement Intern, you'll support the group's analytical work. You'll partner with the managers who own quality and performance measurement to test the data, run original analyses, spot trends early, and turn your findings into recommendations leaders can act on. This goes beyond reporting, the question is never only "what does the number say?" It's also "is this measuring the right thing, and what should we do about it?"

You'll build skills in analysis, metric design, and structured problem solving, and see up close how an AI-first quality and performance program runs in a regulated industry. The best person for this role doesn't only meet a high bar; they hold their own work to one.

 


IN THIS ROLE, YOU’LL HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO

 - Design and run trending analyses across scorecard metrics to inform target reviews, and build a repeatable way of doing them so each review doesn't start from scratch

 - Look for relationships between metrics, such as how quality, satisfaction and efficiency move together, and turn what you find into clear charts and recommendations

 - Help define and document metrics: what each one measures, where its data comes from, and where two metrics overlap or one is only raw input to another

 - Build checks and first-pass reviews that help the team catch errors in scorecards and reports before they’re finalized

 - Support analysis of quality data, such as sampling and summarizing results, as projects call for it


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Strong quantitative and spreadsheet skills, and comfort cleaning, joining and pivoting messy data (SQL is a plus)

 - An understanding of how relational data fits together (tables, keys, joins). SQL is a plus but not required

 - Experience building trend analyses and visualizations, and the judgment to tell a real pattern from noise

 - Basic familiarity with statistical concepts like correlation, sample sizes and significance

 - Basic familiarity with ticketing tools and support systems, and where support data comes from

 - Structured problem solving: you can turn a vague question into a hypothesis, an analysis and a clear "so what"

 - Clear writing, including explaining a finding to the person who has to act on it

 - Ownership and a bias to action, taking work from question to recommendation




ELIGIBILITY

✔ Currently enrolled as a student at a Canadian post-secondary institution or technical bootcamp

✔ New graduates - Within 6 months of your graduation date

✔ Available to work full-time hours

✔ Residing in Canada

 Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen. 
 Role Overview 
 The Creative Innovations team at Electronic Arts develops core pipeline technologies that power character deformation, facial rigging, and digital likeness across global franchises. As an AI Engineer Intern embedded with our character pipeline group, you will focus on developing, prototyping, and integrating machine learning models and neural networks directly into production animation workflows. You will collaborate with software engineers, technical artists, and AI scientists to build practical, intelligent tools that automate complex character deformation and enhance artist workflows. 
 What You Will Do 
 You will design, train, and evaluate machine learning models tailored for 3D character deformation and automated facial performance. Rather than working solely on ingestion infrastructure, you will write application code and train neural networks using both raw 3D capture data that requires cleaning and high-fidelity, artist-tuned reference assets. You will build and refine models that predict blendshapes, create mesh deformations, and automate landmark tracking, ensuring that model predictions align with artist intent and production quality standards. 
 In addition to core model development, you will integrate these AI systems into our modern character pipeline stack. You will write clean, production-quality Python code, using USD schemas to connect training environments with digital content creation software such as Autodesk Maya and Houdini. You will package and deploy your code and model environments using Docker to ensure execution across local workstations and cloud platforms (such as Amazon Web Services services). You will also use and experiment with AI developer agents to accelerate coding, testing, and pipeline automation tasks. 
 What You Bring 

- You are enrolled in a bachelors degree program in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Graphics, or a related technical discipline. 

- You have practical programming skills in Python and a solid conceptual and applied foundation in machine learning, specifically around deep learning and neural network architectures. 

- Experience training, evaluating, and fine-tuning models using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow is necessary , along with a practical approach to handling both noisy raw data and curated datasets. 

- You have a working knowledge of fundamental 3D geometry concepts, linear algebra, and coordinate transformations as they apply to mesh topology and deformation. 

- Practical experience containerizing applications with Docker and collaborating through Git and modern version control platforms is required. 

- Familiarity with USD, digital content creation APIs in Maya or Houdini, model inference optimization, or the effective prompting and use of AI coding agents will help you ramp up quickly. 

- Most importantly, you bring clear technical communication and a genuine enthusiasm for applying artificial intelligence to creative character technology. 

 You  must  be available for a  full-time  paid internship in the summer of 2027. 
 At this time, we are considering  Undergrad  students who will be enrolled in an accredited degree program in the summer of 2027, slated to graduate  no earlier than December 2027 .  EA’s Character Animation Research Team (known as the A-Team) is a small team based in Vancouver, British Columbia. We’re committed to advancing the field of Character Animation. Our vision of the future is one where video-games characters not only look believable, but move convincingly, as well. Our technology is shared across multiple games in EA including FC, Madden, NHL, skate.™, Battlefront, Dragon Age and more. 
 We're looking for an  undergraduate Animator Co-op student  to join our EA SPORTS Tech A-Team for an  8-month internship beginning in May 2027.  You'll receive mentorship from our Senior Technical Animator and collaborate directly with experienced animators, engineers, and ML experts to help shape the future of character animation. 
 Unlike a traditional game team animation role, this internship offers the unique opportunity to work directly with the team building the technologies that power animation across EA. You'll gain hands-on experience with these tools and systems, develop an understanding of how they're created and improved, and build valuable skills that can translate to virtually any game team. 
 Responsibilities: 

- Become familiar with EA’s proprietary game engine, the Frostbite Engine. 

- Refine and polish motion capture animation to AAA game quality.  

- Learn to build modern animation systems such as state machines, motion matching, and node based programming. 

- Brainstorm and collaborate side-by-side with engineers and UX designers to design and refine animation workflows/pipelines. 

- Learn how partner game teams work across EA by assisting with tool adoption, debugging, and workflow feedback. 

 We encourage candidates from all backgrounds  who meet the core requirements  to apply,   even if you do not meet every qualification.  

 Requirements: 

- You must be legally authorized to work in Canada for the entire internship -  visa sponsorship is not available.  

- You must be enrolled in an accredited degree program and return to school for at least one semester following your internship with EA. 

- You must be graduating in May 2028 or later , including the time needed to complete your internship (for example, you must be returning to school for at least 1 semester following your co-op with EA).  

- Relocation support may be available if you meet specific eligibility criteria. 

 Qualifications: 

- Currently pursuing a degree in Animation  or a related technical discipline. 

- Entry-level experience; prior internship, coursework, or personal projects in animation. 

- Experience creating high-quality character animation. 

- Solid foundation in character animation principles and body mechanics. 

- Familiarity with industry-standard 3D software tools such as Autodesk Maya, MotionBuilder, or equivalent. 

- Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to quickly identify and resolve issues. 

- Interest in motion capture data, rigging, or scripting (Python/DCC tools) is a plus. 

 Preferred Technical Skills (Nice-to-Haves) 

- Python scripting. 

- Node-based programming. 

- Interest in vibe-coding and using AI agents in their work.

- You must clearly indicate your expected graduation date in your resume to be considered. 

- Submit a portfolio/ demo reel with your animations.

- Are you involved in any extra-curricular activities or clubs? We want to hear about them! 

- Submit a cover letter and tell us why you’re interested in this position with EA!

 Description & Requirements

 Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

 We Are EA 
 At Electronic Arts, we create experiences that inspire players and communities around the world. Making great games is challenging, and it takes creative, curious, and passionate people working together to make those experiences possible.

 EA Digital Platform : Gameplay Services 
 The EA Digital Platform provides shared technology and services that help game teams tap into the power of the global EA ecosystem. By building reusable capabilities that can be integrated across games, we enable our studios to focus on what they do best, creating incredible experiences for players.
 Within Gameplay Services, we build and operate online capabilities used across EA games, including Stats & Leaderboards .

 The Challenge Ahead 
 Stats & Leaderboards touches player experiences across EA's portfolio. Our technology helps games capture player statistics, track progress and accomplishments, compare players and friends, and power leaderboard experiences.
 Behind those experiences are highly available, distributed backend systems designed to process and serve player data at scale.

 As a Software Engineer Intern , you'll work alongside experienced engineers to build and improve these production services. You'll get hands-on experience solving real engineering problems while contributing to software that improves player experiences across EA games. You will report to a Technical Director on the team.

 What You'll Do 

- Design and implement backend features using Java and Spring Boot .

- Build and evolve service interfaces using gRPC and Protocol Buffers .

- Work with PostgreSQL and Redis to store, retrieve, and process player statistics and leaderboard data.

- Develop and run services in a Kubernetes-based environment.

- Write production-quality code along with unit and integration tests.

- Investigate and debug issues using logs, metrics, traces, and other observability tools.

- Learn how we design and optimize distributed systems for performance, scalability, reliability, and availability .

- Participate in code reviews and technical design discussions with experienced engineers.

- Collaborate with engineers across Gameplay Services and EA game teams.

- Participate in the team's sprint cycle, including stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, demos, and retrospectives.

- Own a well-scoped engineering project or feature from design and implementation through testing and delivery.

 What We're Looking For 

- Pursuing a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering , or a related technical field.

- Programming experience with Java and an understanding of object-oriented programming.

- Understanding of core computer science concepts including data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and databases .

- Curiosity about how large-scale systems work.

- A player- and customer-focused mindset—you think about how the technology you build ultimately affects the people using it.

 Exposure to any of the following:

- Spring / Spring Boot 

- gRPC and Protocol Buffers 

- PostgreSQL or other relational databases 

- Redis or other caching technologies 

- Docker and Kubernetes 

- Microservices or distributed systems

- Cloud technologies

- Automated testing and CI/CD

- Performance testing, profiling, or optimization

 What You'll Learn 
 You'll experience the full software development lifecycle on a production engineering team—from understanding requirements and participating in technical design to implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
 You'll gain practical experience with Java, Spring Boot, gRPC, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Kubernetes while learning how distributed backend services are built and operated at EA scale.
 Through mentorship, code reviews, design discussions, and hands-on development, you'll learn from experienced engineers while gradually taking greater ownership of your work.
 Most importantly, you'll ship meaningful software that contributes to player experiences across EA's games.

 You  must  be available for a  full-time  paid internship in the summer of 2026. 
 At this time, we are considering  Bachelor's  students who will be enrolled in an accredited degree program in the summer of 2027, slated to graduate  no earlier than December 2027 . Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada on a full-time basis during the 16-week internship. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. 
 Please ensure that your graduation date is visible on your resume.

 Why YOU Want This Position 
 At Enverus, we’re committed to empowering the global quality of life by helping our customers make energy affordable and accessible to the world.

 The energy industry is changing fast. But we’ve continued to lead the way in energy technology, creating intelligent connections across the entire energy ecosystem, from renewables, power and utilities, to oil and gas and financial institutions. Our solutions create more efficient production and distribution, capital allocation, renewable energy development, investment and sourcing, and help reduce costs by automating crucial business operations. - Aggregate, clean and analyze large data sets to identify trends, characterize opportunities, value assets and analyze market activity using internal workflows built in Enverus Prism™.

- Educational experience in business, technical college, or engineering programs.

- Strong computer and word processing skills, thorough knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Excel, Project, PowerPoint, Adobe Acrobat and desktop publishing software.

- Exceptional written communication and editing skills.

- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Understand and able to communicate the technical aspects of underground mine

- contracting.

- Able to work independently and in a team environment.

- Capacity to work effectively with deadlines and short-time frames.

- Ability to execute multiple projects simultaneously.

- Commitment to a healthy and safe working environment.

- Excellent compensation and comprehensive benefits.

- Performance-based financial rewards.

- Training and career development.

- Global opportunities.

Why YOU Want This Position 
 At Enverus, we’re committed to empowering the global quality of life by helping our customers make energy affordable and accessible to the world.  
 We are the most trusted energy-dedicated SaaS company, with a platform built to maximize value from generative AI, and our innovative solutions are reshaping the way energy is consumed and managed. By offering anytime, anywhere access to analytics and insights, we’re helping our customers make better decisions that help provide communities around the world with clean, affordable energy. 
 The energy industry is changing fast. But we’ve continued to lead the way in energy technology, creating intelligent connections across the entire energy ecosystem, from renewables, power and utilities, to oil and gas and financial institutions. Our solutions create more efficient production and distribution, capital allocation, renewable energy development, investment and sourcing, and help reduce costs by automating crucial business operations. Of course, this wouldn’t be possible without our people, which is why we have built a team of individuals from a diverse range of backgrounds.  
 Are you ready to help power the global quality of life? Join Enverus, and be a part of creating a brighter, more sustainable tomorrow. 

 We are seeking a highly motivated individual to serve as an Intern on our Enverus Intelligence Research team (EIR) with a focus on Power Markets. You will collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of engineers, financial analysts, and geologists to ensure data integrity, analyze trends and publish actionable investment research for investment banks, private equity, hedge funds, institutional investors as well as energy companies. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong analytical and communication skills and excels in a fast paced, dynamic environment. 

 This full-time role is based out of our Calgary office. We look forward to welcoming the successful candidate for a  12-month term beginning in January 2027. 

 Performance Objectives

- Aggregate, clean and analyze large data sets to identify trends, characterize opportunities, value assets and analyze market activity using internal workflows built in Enverus Prism™. 

- Update, maintain and improve proprietary databases critical for formulating opinions on assets including well production data, renewable projects and financial data. 

- Participate in conference calls with clients and prospects, leveraging or demonstrating Enverus Intelligence™ and Enverus Core™ solutions to help answer some of the most challenging questions facing the energy industry and energy investors today. 

- Maintain forecasting models using SEC filings, investor documents, transcripts, press releases, and government and industry datasets.  

 Competitive Candidate Profile

- Pursuing an undergraduate degree in Engineering, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field 

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, with a specific focus on Excel 

- Proficiency with Python and Data Manipulation 

- Familiarity with using programming concepts to manage and analyze large, complex datasets. 

- Excellent interpersonal, organizational and communication skills, strong attention to detail, self-motivated with a strong work ethic 

- A demonstrated passion for the energy sector

 Cheers to creating an incredible tomorrow!        

 At Molson Coors, we tackle big challenges and defy the status quo.   With a proud legacy of excellence, an incredible portfolio of beer, seltzers, spirits, and non-alcohol brands, and a bold vision for our future... we’re on the path to transforming the beverage industry.   That requires remarkable individuals who are curious, tenacious, and never afraid to fail forward.

 Here’s to crafting careers and creating new legacies.

 As a Commercial Enablement Sales Intern, you will be part of the Canadian Commercial team in Toronto within our Early Talent Program. Our Early Talent Program is Molson Coors’ undergraduate summer internship program, where students are exposed to the beverage industry, engaged in real-world problem-solving, and immersed in social and educational opportunities with other interns.  The internship is a full-time summer position from May 3 - August 6 (Canada interns) and May 25 - August 6 (U.S. interns).   

 This position works closely with the Canadian Commercial Sales team in each region to assist us in creating positive brand experiences and delighting our customers and consumers.  

 What You’ll Be Brewing:   

-

-

-

- 
 Process Improvement: Help document, evaluate, and improve business processes by identifying efficiencies and opportunities to simplify workflows.   

-

- 
 Presentation Excellence: Develop compelling presentations that communicate insights, recommendations, project updates, and business outcomes to stakeholders.   

-

- 
 Project Coordination: Assist with project planning, stakeholder communication, meeting preparation, documentation, and follow-up activities.   

 Key Ingredients:   

- 
 Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Marketing, or a related field.

 Strong interest in business analytics, technology, data visualization, automation, and digital transformation.   

- 
 Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Outlook, and other Microsoft 365 applications.

 Experience with or willingness to learn Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python, Databricks, or similar analytical tools.

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

 Ability to transform data into meaningful insights and business recommendations.   

- 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills.   

- 
 Ability to work effectively across multiple teams and stakeholder groups.   

- 
 Self-motivated, curious, adaptable, and eager to learn new technologies and business processes.   

- 
 Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.   

- 
 Participation in extracurricular activities, case competitions, student leadership, or analytics projects is considered an asset.

Manulife is seeking two Articling Students for a 10-month articling placement within its in-house legal department for the 2027-2028 articling term, providing hands-on experience in commercial, corporate, regulatory, and litigation matters. This articling opportunity, beginning in July 2027, will appeal to individuals interested in business and financial services law who love to take initiative, are client-focused, and are exceptionally strong in delivering high-quality results.

 As part of the placement, you will work with a high-caliber legal team in a leading global financial services organization.

 Our articling program offers :

- Comprehensive mentorship and training from senior legal professionals.

- Exposure to complex and high-profile legal matters in financial services law.

- A collaborative and inclusive environment with a strong focus on professional development.

 Responsibilities :
 You will work closely with experienced in-house counsel on a broad range of legal matters. Some of the key responsibilities of the Articling Student in their placement are to:

- Support Manulife lawyers in providing strategic and risk-informed legal advice. 

- Conduct legal research and legal writing.

- Assist with contract drafting, policy reviews, regulatory compliance, corporate matters, and litigation strategy.

- Participate in regular meetings with the Articling Principal, and other internal meetings as the need arises and in-house training opportunities.

- Travel to different Manulife offices as required.

 Education and Experience: 

- Law degree and a strong academic background.

- Demonstrated interest in commercial, corporate, regulatory, litigation, and/or insurance law, with prior experience in a legal setting considered an asset.

 Who We’re Looking For: 

- Highly motivated and proactive self-starter with a strong work ethic.

- Strong legal research, writing, and analytical skills, with the ability to communicate complex legal concepts clearly and effectively to both legal and business audiences.

- Advocacy, problem-solving and conflict resolution skills.

- A high level of comfort working with technology and a keen passion for learning new systems, including digital literacy of MS Office and web-based legal research tools and other web-based resources.

- Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work cross-collaboratively.

- Strong client service mindset.

- Demonstrated attention to detail.

- Critical thinker able to work well independently with minimal supervision as well as in a team environment.

- Proven time management skills and ability to deal with conflicting priorities and deadlines.

- Ability to investigate facts, identify issues, determine organizational objectives, consider alternative solutions, analyze risk and advise clients on the appropriate course of action.

 Compensation: 
 The salary range for this position is $80,000 to $90,000 CAD per annum, which will be prorated for the 10-month articling term.

 To apply for one of these placements, you will be required to submit the following:

- Cover letter (please address your letter to the Manulife Articling Committee).

- Resume.

- Law school transcripts, plus final year course selection.

- Two professional/academic reference letters.
